messages.author: 85710a48a204a0a6
messages.subject: Constrained interaction term in multigroup latent model
parts:
Dear all: first of all thank you very much for all the support. This has proved invaluable as I attempted to test a multigroup latent interaction. 

I am currently am experiencing an [Error in varEst[targetcol, targetcol] : subscript out of bounds] error when using the command probe2WayRC 

The error may be due to having constrained some of the terms to be the same across groups in the model. After testing for invariance, constraining a main effect and the interaction terms to be the same across groups does not significantly affect the fit of the model. But now I cannot probe the interaction.

I was wondering whether this is a limitation of the function? Or perhaps a limitation of the model? 

Thank you 
GAT

messages.author: 85710a48a204a0a6
messages.subject: Re: Constrained interaction term in multigroup latent model
parts:
Thanks for your reply, Alexander. 

With some trials and many errors, I think I have found the little bug (if even it's a bug) hiding behind this. 
When you run this, it should give you the error message of out of bounds (I am using the same style of labelling I use in my model to constrains variables).


dat2wayRC <- orthogonalize(dat2way, 1:3, 4:6)
dat2wayRC$g <- 1:2

model2 <- "
f1  =~ x1 + x2 + x3
f2  =~ x4 + x5 + x6
f12 =~ x1.x4 + x2.x5 + x3.x6
f3  =~ x7 + x8 + x9

f3 ~ f1 + q1*f2 + r1*f12

f12 ~~ 0*f1 + 0*f2

x1 + x4 + x1.x4 + x7 ~ 0*1 # identify latent means
f1 + f2 + f12 ~ NA*1
f3 ~ NA*1 + c(b0.g1, b0.g2)*1
"
fit2 <- sem(model2, data = dat2wayRC, group = "g")

probe2WayRC(fit2, nameX = c("f2", "f1", "f12"), nameY = "f3",
            modVar = "f2", valProbe = c(-1, 0, 1), group = 2)

BUT this below will run just fine (The only difference between the codes is the position of the "f2" in the probe2WayRC).  


model2 <- "
f1  =~ x1 + x2 + x3
f2  =~ x4 + x5 + x6
f12 =~ x1.x4 + x2.x5 + x3.x6
f3  =~ x7 + x8 + x9

f3 ~ f1 + q1*f2 + r1*f12

f12 ~~ 0*f1 + 0*f2

x1 + x4 + x1.x4 + x7 ~ 0*1 # identify latent means
f1 + f2 + f12 ~ NA*1
f3 ~ NA*1 + c(b0.g1, b0.g2)*1
"
fit2 <- sem(model2, data = dat2wayRC, group = "g")

probe2WayRC(fit2, nameX = c("f1", "f2", "f12"), nameY = "f3",
            modVar = "f2", valProbe = c(-1, 0, 1), group = 2)

messages.subject: Re: Constrained interaction term in multigroup latent model
parts:
Damn, I thought I resolved all the name-order issues.  I opened an issue on GitHub so you can see when it gets resolved (not this week).

https://github.com/simsem/semTools/issues/103

I might just change the documentation to explicitly state that order matters.  It kind of has to in probe3WayRC(), and it would be consistent to set the focal predictor first.  I wish we could just name the focal predictor and moderator(s) like in the interactions package, but of course the latent interaction factors could be named any old thing, so we're kind of stuck with this nameX= argument.
